definitions.explanation: A large, mild-flavored white radish commonly used in Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}おろし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大根|だいこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かせない：24096_kakasenai⟧。
{大根|だいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}て→煮る：01971_niru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|し}み{込|こ}ませる→染み込む：07893_shimikomu⟧。
examples.english: To simmer daikon until the flavor soaks in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大根|だいこん}おろし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: To serve grilled fish with grated daikon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大根|だいこん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧、⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Winter daikon is sweet and delicious when made into simmered dishes.

notes:
{大根|だいこん} is one of the most important vegetables in Japanese cuisine.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- {大根|だいこん}おろし: grated daikon (served with grilled fish)
- ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大根|だいこん}: simmered daikon in oden
- ⟦{切|き}り{干|ぼ}し{大根|だいこん}→切り干し大根：08093_kiriboshidaikon⟧: dried shredded daikon
- ⟦たくあん→沢庵：13302_takuan⟧: pickled daikon

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大根役者|だいこんやくしゃ}: a ham, a bad actor. A popular explanation: daikon never gives you food poisoning (⟦{当|あ}たらない→当たる：01860_ataru⟧), and a bad actor never has a hit (also ⟦{当|あ}たらない→当たる：01860_ataru⟧).
